#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
exec >>/home/phat/ml-experiments/dbb5314989eb/fault.log 2>&1
test "$(hostname -s)" = srv01
ip -j -4 address show dev enp0s8 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; assert any(a.get("local")=="192.168.56.20" for link in json.load(sys.stdin) for a in link.get("addr_info",[]))'

echo FAULT_BEFORE $(date -u +%s)

nft add table inet mlv2_dbb5314989eb
nft 'add chain inet mlv2_dbb5314989eb output { type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }'
nft add rule inet mlv2_dbb5314989eb output udp dport 53 counter drop
nft add rule inet mlv2_dbb5314989eb output tcp dport 53 counter drop
nft list table inet mlv2_dbb5314989eb
